evidence: Spokane Mayor Lisa Brown described the situation to the BBC as "the worst natural disaster our region has faced"

evidence: authorities were assessing the extent of the damage

nary_nodes.label: Authorities discussing potential for lives lost
evidence: were "still discussing the potential for lives to be lost"

evidence: No deaths or injuries have been confirmed.

evidence: Investigators have yet to work out how the blazes started.

evidence: a total number of 16 large, uncontained wildfires on the landscape in Washington state as of Monday morning

nary_nodes.label: NWS warned of critical fire weather
evidence: The National Weather Service (NWS) had warned of "extremely critical" fire weather over the weekend

nary_nodes.label: Winds and dry conditions helped flames spread
evidence: strong winds and unusually dry conditions helping the flames spread rapidly

nary_nodes.label: Videos show smoke and fires
evidence: Videos from Spokane - the second most populous city in the state - show huge plumes of smoke and roaring fires tearing through houses

nary_nodes.label: Helicopters trying to put out flames
evidence: helicopters fly above trying to put out the flames

nary_nodes.label: 700 buildings destroyed
evidence: The fires have destroyed around 700 buildings, including homes, businesses and other buildings.

nary_nodes.label: 10,000 electricity customers without power
evidence: More than 10,000 electricity customers were left without power on Sunday

nary_nodes.label: Half of customers had power restored
evidence: By Monday, around half of them had their power restored.

nary_nodes.label: Governor Ferguson declares statewide emergency
evidence: Washington State Governor Bob Ferguson has declared a statewide emergency

nary_nodes.label: Governor Ferguson requests federal assistance
evidence: and requested federal assistance after speaking with US President Donald Trump.

nary_nodes.label: Fires named Spokane Complex Fires
evidence: The three fires around Spokane - Old Trails, Fairview and Autumn Lane - have been together named the Spokane Complex Fires.

nary_nodes.label: Fire jumped Spokane River
evidence: the fire jumped over the Spokane River at least twice

nary_nodes.label: Officials say fire jumped Spokane River
Official describes burned area as war zone
evidence: one official said the burned area looks like a "war zone"

nary_nodes.label: Maj Gen Welsh compares scene to Iraq
evidence: Maj Gen Gent Welsh, who commands the state's National Guard, said the scene reminded him of his time serving in the US military in Iraq.

nary_nodes.label: Sheriff Nowels says officials trying to contact 14 people
evidence: Spokane County Sheriff John Nowels said that officials were trying to contact 14 people to confirm they managed to safely evacuate.

nary_nodes.label: Mayor Brown urges public vigilance and compliance
evidence: Mayor Brown said: "The most important thing is that people need to remain vigilant and be patient and comply when we ask them to be ready to evacuate or when we say it's time to evacuate."

nary_nodes.label: Forecasters warn temperatures likely to rise
evidence: forecasters have warned temperatures are likely to rise again later in the week.

nary_nodes.label: Gov Ferguson issues statewide ban on outdoor fires
evidence: On Monday, Gov Ferguson issued a statewide ban on all outdoor fires.

nary_nodes.label: Dave Upthegrove states firefighters stretched thin
evidence: Commissioner of Public Lands Dave Upthegrove in a written statement: "Our firefighters are already stretched thin across the state"

nary_nodes.label: Dave Upthegrove warns of new sparks leading to wildfires
evidence: any new spark on our tinder dry landscapes can lead to another devastating wildfire.

nary_nodes.label: Dave Upthegrove urges Washingtonians not to be the spark
evidence: I'm urging all Washingtonians to not be that spark.

nary_nodes.label: 900+ firefighters assigned to blazes
evidence: More than 900 firefighters are currently assigned to the blazes in Washington

nary_nodes.label: Reinforcements expected to arrive
evidence: with more reinforcements expected to arrive from other states in the coming days.

nary_nodes.label: Officials remind public about illegal drone flying
evidence: Officials are reminding the public that it is illegal to fly drones near the fires

nary_nodes.label: Drones disrupted operations 26 times
evidence: Drones disrupted operations 26 times on Sunday.

nary_nodes.label: Scientists say climate change makes conditions more likely
evidence: Scientists have said that human-induced climate change makes the warm, dry conditions that lead to wildfires more likely - as well as leading to more frequent and intense heatwaves, and potential summer droughts.
